title: Kusoma kwa Mapana (Theme 2: Lishe bora)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 7 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child judges a text by its title, blurb and first page, then reads it for one message.

floor.prerequisite: Reads a short story and answers who and what.
floor.question: Hadithi hii inamhusu nani?

representations: three real books from the class library
the five-finger check on one page
steps: Read the title and the back.
Read the first page; count unknown words.
Say the message in one sentence.

board.do: Point at the title and the back cover.
Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child reads the first page and shows the five-finger check.

misconceptions.ask: Jalada linakuambia nini kuhusu maneno yaliyo ndani?
misconceptions.repair: Anwani, maelezo ya nyuma ya kitabu na ukurasa wa kwanza hukuambia kitabu kinahusu nini.

misconceptions.ask: Ni maneno mangapi kwenye ukurasa huu ambayo hujui?
misconceptions.repair: Matini ifaayo ni ile unayoweza kuisoma na kuielewa ukiwa peke yako.

misconceptions.ask: Mwandishi anataka ujifunze nini baada ya kusoma?
misconceptions.repair: Anwani hutaja mada; ujumbe ni funzo au wazo kuu ambalo mwandishi anataka ulipate.

misconceptions.ask: Je, jambo hili linahusu matini yote au sehemu moja tu?
misconceptions.repair: Ujumbe unahusu matini yote; jambo moja dogo ni maelezo tu.

misconceptions.ask: Matini hii imepangwa kwa aya au kwa beti?
misconceptions.repair: Shairi lina beti na mishororo; hadithi ina aya; gazeti lina habari na tarehe.

misconceptions.ask: Sentensi inayozunguka neno hili inakuambia nini?
misconceptions.repair: Soma sentensi nzima: "mlo" hapa ni chakula anachokula mtu kwa wakati mmoja.

checks.question: Ni ipi ni ujumbe wa matini kuhusu lishe bora: "Mama alipika sukumawiki na ugali." au "Mlo kamili wenye vyakula vya aina mbalimbali hujenga afya."?
checks.answer: Mlo kamili wenye vyakula vya aina mbalimbali hujenga afya.

checks.question: Matini yenye beti ni ya aina gani?
